title: PCI DSS for payment card data
description: Proposed when the stack names a card payment provider, or to the security, finance and legal roles. Select when the project stores, processes or transmits payment card data, or can affect its security. The self-assessment questionnaire that applies depends on the payment integration: under SAQ A, every element of the payment page comes only and directly from a PCI DSS compliant provider and the merchant stores, processes and transmits no account data on its own systems, so most of these rules do not apply; the acquirer confirms which questionnaire applies.
